description: Ministry of Health - Approval of the Parliament under Subsection 4 of Section 72 of Medical Ordinance
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the parliamentary approval of regulations ("Procedure for Election of Members Regulation No. 01 of 2021") made under the Medical Ordinance. It deals with the legal/regulatory framework for electing members to the Sri Lanka Medical Council, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations and statutory instruments).
